scope revised 2026-09-22: no longer 'rename to Renderer'. RenderDeviceState::record is a product-level frame executor (prepare -> begin -> recordFamily -> publish -> view compose -> UI compose -> display compose -> capture); a rename would keep 'Framework owns the frame arrangement' alive under a nicer name

target: app-side RuntimeRenderContext owns frame flight, scene/view plan, submission, surface present targets, the record order after acquire, Game UI binding, and pre/post-present policy; Framework keeps Forward/Deferred/ViewComposePass/DisplayComposePass/PostProcess/RenderGraph/FrameRecording

RuntimeRenderContext is not the forbidden 'new Framework coordinator': it lives app-side, holds what RenderDeviceState already holds today, and is justified by the test in plan section 3 (does it need to know the app's Scenes / Views / windows)
public entry stays init/shutdown/record/publishedViewOutput; no plan-wide Renderer facade (see plan section 5)
